profile.headline: Software Engineer | UC Berkeley Alumnus
profile.summary:
I’m a UC Berkeley alum with a background in Data Science, Cognitive Science, and Computer Science, currently building at two startups where I focus on creating impactful data and software solutions. My interests span software architecture, full-stack development, database systems, embedded systems, machine learning, and AI, and I’m always looking for opportunities to push my technical skills further.

I love to tell stories with data and transform insights into real-world impact. I thrive in collaborative, fast-paced environments where I can learn continuously while contributing to meaningful projects.

Beyond my technical work, I’m passionate about broadening access to technology. Through nonprofit work and STEM tutoring, I’ve worked to expand opportunities in underrepresented communities, an effort that fuels my drive to not only grow in tech, but to help others grow alongside me.
